definitions.gloss: Year of the Tiger (in the zodiac)
definitions.explanation: The Year of the Tiger, one of the twelve years of the Chinese/Japanese zodiac ({十二支|じゅうにし}). A person born in such a year is said to be 'a tiger.'

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}は{寅年|とらどし}だ。
examples.english: Next year is the Year of the Tiger.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{寅年|とらどし}{生|う}まれです。
examples.english: I was born in the Year of the Tiger.

examples.japanese: {年賀状|ねんがじょう}には、{寅年|とらどし}にちなんでかわいい{虎|とら}のイラストを{描|か}いた。
examples.english: On my New Year's cards I drew a cute tiger illustration in honor of the Year of the Tiger.

notes:
One of the twelve zodiac years ({十二支|じゅうにし}); the tiger is the third sign. People often mention their zodiac year as an indirect way of referring to their age.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寅年|とらどし}{生|う}まれ: born in the Year of the Tiger
- {今年|ことし}は{寅年|とらどし}: this year is the Year of the Tiger

NOTE:
The zodiac uses the special kanji {寅|とら} rather than the everyday {虎|とら} for 'tiger,' though both are read とら.
